items.exampleEn: After months abroad, he yearned to see his family.
items.exampleZh: 在國外待了好幾個月後，他非常想見家人。

items.exampleEn: He loves to brag about his cooking.
items.exampleZh: 他很愛吹噓自己的廚藝。

items.exampleEn: We had a few idle minutes before the film, so we bought popcorn.
items.exampleZh: 電影開始前我們有幾分鐘空檔，就去買了爆米花。

items.exampleEn: She waited patiently for the bus in the rain.
items.exampleZh: 她在雨中耐心地等公車。

items.exampleEn: The law protects animals from cruelty.
items.exampleZh: 法律保護動物不受虐待。

items.exampleEn: He watched the end of the game with an indifferent look.
items.exampleZh: 他帶著一副無所謂的表情看完比賽的最後一段。

items.exampleEn: The ad deceived customers with false prices.
items.exampleZh: 那則廣告用假的價格欺騙顧客。

items.exampleEn: He felt anguish over the unkind words he had said to his friend.
items.exampleZh: 他為自己對朋友說過的刻薄話感到痛苦。

items.sentenceEn: My bike has been sitting idle in the garage all winter.
items.sentenceZh: 我的腳踏車整個冬天都閒置在車庫裡。

items.audioEn: My brother is indifferent to fashion; he wears the same jacket every day.
items.audioZh: 我的兄弟對時尚一點也不在乎，他每天都穿同一件外套。
items.questionZh: 說話者的兄弟對時尚的態度是什麼？
options: He doesn't care how he looks

items.sentenceEn: Don't let a friendly smile deceive you.
The teacher patiently explained the problem three times.
items.sentenceZh: 老師耐心地把那道題講解了三遍。

items.stemEn: The film shows the ____ of keeping wild animals in small cages.
items.stemZh: 那部電影呈現把野生動物關在小籠子裡的殘忍。

items.stemEn: He won the race, but he didn't ____ at all.
items.stemZh: 他贏了比賽，卻一點也沒有炫耀。

items.passageEn: In English class, we read a story about a young king. Proud of his gold, he would brag to every visitor, and he spent his days idle in the palace while his people worked hard. He was indifferent to their problems until a clever servant deceived him into dressing as a poor farmer for a day. Out in the fields, the king finally saw the cruelty of the high taxes he had set, and he felt real anguish. When he went back, he patiently listened to his people for the first time. After that, he often yearned for the simple life he had seen in the village. The ending was a little predictable, but we all enjoyed the story.
items.passageZh: 英文課上，我們讀了一個關於年輕國王的故事。他以自己的黃金為傲，見到訪客就炫耀，整天在宮裡無所事事，而人民卻辛苦工作。他對人民的問題漠不關心，直到一位聰明的僕人騙他扮成窮農夫過一天。到了田裡，國王終於看到自己訂的高稅有多殘酷，心裡感到真正的痛苦。回宮之後，他第一次耐心地聽人民說話。從那之後，他常常嚮往在村子裡看到的簡單生活。結局有點可以猜到，但我們都很喜歡這個故事。

options: 被僕人騙去扮成窮農夫
他想親自去收那些高額的稅
他聽說村子裡有很好吃的食物
耐心地聽人民說出他們的問題
又開始炫耀自己的財富

items.promptZh: 那位老闆對員工的感受漠不關心。
referenceEn: That boss is indifferent to his employees' feelings.
The boss is indifferent to how his staff feel.
rubricZh: indifferent 後面可接 to 或 about（例如 indifferent to his employees' feelings 等）
「員工的感受」可寫，例如 his employees' feelings、how his staff feel 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 is、was 等）

items.promptZh: 很多上班族渴望有更多自由的時間。
referenceEn: Many office workers yearn for more free time.
Many people who work in offices yearn to have more free time.
rubricZh: yearn 後接 for＋名詞或 to＋原形動詞（例如 yearn for more free time、yearn to have… 等）
「上班族」可寫，例如 office workers、people who work in offices 等
